note: The musics a video can play in the background. `start`: where a track is in full swing (seconds), `lufs`: its loudness as recorded; both measured (scripts/make-musics.py --measure). `kinds`, `genre` and `about` (what the AI reads to choose one) come from a model that listened to each track (scripts/make-musics.py --listen, 15/11/2026).

tracks.name: Drift Phonk
tracks.author: sub_clair
tracks.about: Mood: energetic, aggressive. Energy: high. Suits: gaming highlights, fast-paced edits, action montages. Ruins: calm storytelling, slow-motion, or emotional content.

tracks.name: Drift Phonk II
tracks.author: sub_clair
tracks.about: Mood: Energetic, confident, and driving. Energy: High. Suits: Gaming highlights, fast-paced action, and hype montages. Ruins: Calm storytelling, emotional scenes, or slow-paced tutorials.

tracks.name: Night Drift
tracks.author: zephiramusic
tracks.about: Mood: Energetic, aggressive, and fast-paced. Best for: Gaming highlights, action montages, and hype content. It would ruin: Relaxing vlogs, storytelling, or emotional moments.

tracks.name: Energetic Hip-Hop
tracks.author: skilsel
tracks.about: This is an energetic, upbeat hip-hop track with a driving rhythm and modern synth elements. It is perfect for gaming highlights, hype reels, and fast-paced montages. It would ruin slow-paced, emotional, or serious storytelling content.

tracks.name: Stream Starting
tracks.author: the_mountain
tracks.about: Mood: chill and energetic. Suits: casual talk, highlights, and gaming streams. Avoid: intense horror or slow-paced emotional storytelling.

tracks.name: Vlog Intro
tracks.author: kulakovka
tracks.about: This track features a laid-back hip-hop beat with scratching elements. It's perfect for chill storytelling, funny commentary, or casual vlogs. Avoid using it for high-stakes, serious, or intense action content, as the lighthearted vibe will clash with the mood.

tracks.name: Arcade Retro Nights
tracks.author: alex-morgan
tracks.about: Upbeat synthwave with a retro, electronic vibe. Perfect for high-energy highlights, gaming skill showcases, or as background music for commentary. Avoid using it for slow, sad, or overly serious content.

tracks.name: Pixel Chiptune
tracks.author: alex-morgan
tracks.about: Upbeat, retro chiptune track with a fast tempo. Perfect for funny gaming moments or high-energy highlights. Avoid using it for serious, slow-paced, or emotional content.

tracks.name: Pixel Art Soundtrack
tracks.author: echoes_of_lumen
tracks.about: This upbeat chiptune track features retro synth sounds and a steady, energetic pace. It is perfect for gaming highlights, chill streams, or skill showcases. Its bright, digital texture would clash with serious, dark, or emotional content.

tracks.name: 8-Bit Retro
tracks.author: the_mountain
tracks.about: Upbeat, retro chiptune track. High energy and playful mood. Best for funny moments, gaming highlights, and fast-paced edits. Avoid using for serious, sad, or slow-paced content.

tracks.name: Lofi Upbeat
tracks.author: jonasblakewood
tracks.about: Mood: relaxed, upbeat. Energy: moderate. Suits: chill talk, gaming highlights. Ruins: intense horror, serious news, or high-stakes competitive gameplay.

tracks.name: Lofi Upbeat II
tracks.author: kulakovka
tracks.about: A laid-back, upbeat lofi track with steady drums and bright synths. Ideal for chill commentary, gaming highlights, or vlogs. Its consistent energy makes it a safe background choice, though it might feel too casual for high-stakes, intense, or dark content.

tracks.name: Chill Lo-Fi
tracks.author: zephiramusic
tracks.about: Mood: Chill, relaxed, and unobtrusive. Energy: Low. Best for: Background music for talking, storytelling, or casual gaming. Would ruin: High-energy highlights, intense action, or fast-paced montages.
